urban.en: People in Britain were becoming wealthier and even more urban than they had been before.
urban.zh: 英国人变得比以前更富裕，城市化程度也更高了。

urban.en: Staying in the Netherlands, let's hear from Meredith Glaser, CEO of Amsterdam's Urban Cycling Institute.
urban.zh: 留在荷兰，让我们听听阿姆斯特丹城市骑行研究所首席执行官梅雷迪思·格拉瑟的看法。

urban.en: The Industrial Revolution changed Britain from an agricultural society into an urban, industrial society.
urban.zh: 工业革命将英国从一个农业社会转变为一个城市化的工业社会。

urban.en: Cities grow, bringing people together in urban communities for the first time.
urban.zh: 城市不断发展，首次将人们聚集在城市社区中。

urban.en: The country moved from an economy focused on farming to an urban and industrial and service-based society.
urban.zh: 这个国家从一个以农业为主的经济体，转型为一个城市化、工业化和以服务业为主的社会。

urge.en: Unfortunately, nobody’s walking around with a big neon sign urging us to quit.
urge.zh: 不幸的是，没有人带着亮眼的霓虹灯走来敦促我们放弃。

urge.en: After I quit, my mom sent me a few long handwritten letters urging me to come back to the Kingdom Hall.
urge.zh: 我退教后，我妈给我寄了几封长信，都是亲笔写的，劝我回王国聚会所去。

urge.en: I can't think or work anymore, so much so it woke me at 4 a.m. this morning and I felt a strong urge to tidy.
urge.zh: 我再也无法思考或工作了，以至于今天早上4点把我吵醒，我感到有一种强烈的冲动想要去收拾。

urge.en: And, that fundamental human urge has allowed thousands of people over human history to better themselves by creating cheaper and better ways to banish darkness.
urge.zh: 正是这种根本性的人类需求，让人类历史上成千上万的人得以通过发明更便宜、更好的方式来驱散黑暗，从而改善自己的处境。

urgent.en: Just like passing the driving test gave me a clear and urgent reason to learn.
urgent.zh: 就像通过驾考给了我一个清晰而紧迫的学习理由一样。

urgent.en: Supporters say this would stop permanent members from blocking urgent action.
urgent.zh: 支持者表示，这将阻止常任理事国阻挠紧急行动。

urgent.en: Countries have used the veto to protect their own interests, even in situations where urgent action was needed.
urgent.zh: 各国曾利用否决权来保护他们自己的利益，甚至在需要采取紧急行动的情况下也是如此。

urgent.en: Some thought they were being invited to an urgent meeting.
urgent.zh: 有些人以为他们是被邀请去参加一个紧急会议。

urgent.en: And it was into this world—a world of vast wealth, complicated family politics, and an increasingly urgent need for a younger, more dynamic leadership—that we find Mohammed bin Salman, MBS.
urgent.zh: 正是在这样一个世界里——一个拥有巨额财富、复杂的家族政治以及对年轻、更有活力的领导层日益迫切需求的世界——我们迎来了穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（MBS）。

uranium.en: Later that same year, they discovered radium a substance far more radioactive than uranium.
uranium.zh: 同年晚些时候，他们发现了镭（radium），这是一种放射性远超铀的物质。

uranium.en: Pitchblende was radioactive, and Marie noticed that it was actually more radioactive than uranium.
uranium.zh: 沥青铀矿具有放射性，玛丽注意到它的放射性实际上比铀还要强。

uranium.en: Then, a neutron is fired at the nucleus of a Uranium-235 atom, splitting it.
uranium.zh: 接着，一个中子被发射到铀-235原子的原子核上，将其分裂。

uranium.en: It is one of the world’s largest exporters of wheat, potash, and uranium.
uranium.zh: 它是世界最大的小麦、钾肥和铀出口国之一。

uranium.en: Unlike coal, oil, or natural gas, uranium was not controlled by a single group of countries.
uranium.zh: 与煤炭、石油或天然气不同，铀并不受控于某一特定国家集团。
